//: Typecheck for the accessibility audit (041C) and the performance gate (041D). Playwright transpiles TS without checking it, so without this a spec can carry a type error that only surfaces at test time as a ReferenceError. Scoped to `e2e/a11y` and `e2e/perf` deliberately: the 040A/040B/041B suites predate this config and do not typecheck cleanly under `strict` + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, and widening the include would turn a green repo into a red one over pre-existing debt that is not this task's. `e2e/visual/support` and `tests/cross-layer/harness` are pulled in transitively because both suites build on the visual session and the rig config. The application frontend has its own tsconfig under frontend/ checked by its own `typecheck` script.
